draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.58, the 248th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 18th of 19 at DT. He went 194th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (248th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 8 sacks in 2021, 4th of 19 DTs in his class with stats.
